invocation.ci: python3 execution_guard/repo_integrity_guard_v1.py --ci  (fails closed with CI_DIFF_BASE_UNRESOLVABLE if the diff rules cannot run, e.g. shallow checkout or missing base ref)

static_rules.conftest_minimal: a conftest.py may only import os/sys/pathlib/pytest/json/typing/re, may not define pytest_* hooks, may not write attributes or sys.modules/os.environ entries of objects it did not create, may not call subprocess/urllib/http/importlib/setattr
static_rules.no_stdlib_monkeypatch: no file may assign to attributes of builtins/pathlib/importlib/http/ssl/socket/hashlib/io; test code may not assign to subprocess/urllib/os/json/shutil/time/tempfile/sys attributes at import time nor to urllib.request.urlopen anywhere
static_rules.no_sys_modules_injection: sys.modules['literal'] = ... is forbidden in tests; in runtime only for the project's own namespaces
static_rules.no_historical_pins: no pin ledgers; no git cat-file/show in conftest or in tests without a fixture cwd; no git commit/add/push/fetch/checkout from tests without a fixture cwd
static_rules.no_privileged_or_fake_tooling_in_tests: tests may not execute sudo/apt/pip/tee/ln/chmod and may not synthesise subprocess.CompletedProcess for docker/sqlite3/chroot
static_rules.no_tautological_assertions: assertIn(x, {.., x}), assertEqual(x, x) on state without calls, assert True, assert ... or True, assertions swallowed by try/except pass
static_rules.no_automerge_tooling: no gh pr merge / gh pr review --approve / --admin / force-push to main anywhere; direct `git push ... main` only in the frozen legacy workflow list (may only shrink)
static_rules.workflow_guard_integrity: the guard workflow exists, invokes the exact command, has no paths filter, no continue-on-error, fetch-depth 0; frontier-state-consistency keeps the achieved-is-false assertion and cannot be switched off from the mirrored document; no guard workflow may set continue-on-error: true
static_rules.execution_guard_no_achieved_exemption: no execution guard may exempt a change because it claims terminal achievement
static_rules.authority_consistency: truth.achieved must be false unless the owner countersign matches the constant inside the guard; counts must add up; pointer/scoreboard/useful-ownership/ownership-matrix/manifest/hierarchy mirrors must equal the derivation from the authority; fail-closed manifest records must exist; summary.blocker must stay non-empty while terminal is false

diff_rules_per_pull_request.protected_paths: any change to a protected path fails the automated check; only an in-person owner review may merge it
diff_rules_per_pull_request.governance_flips: a family may move to PASS/VERIFIED_OWNED only with changed evidence references that resolve to existing files; at most family_flips per PR; proved atomic predicates may grow by at most atomic_proved_delta per PR
diff_rules_per_pull_request.fail_closed_records: acceptance_calibration, current_machine_verdict, terminal_predicates, reducer_verification, current_ledger*, blocker, quarantine*, countermodel*, unresolved*, open_famil*, pending*, invalidated*, fail_closed*, donor_deletion_cleanroom, global_ownership_postconditions may change value but may not be deleted or emptied
diff_rules_per_pull_request.receipts: a document claiming independent verification must name a verifier distinct from the producer and carry a run reference; a VERIFY that repeats its RECEIPT's payload hash without a distinct verifier fails; a new PROOF document without a numeric measurement fails; at most new_receipts receipt files per PR
diff_rules_per_pull_request.capability_registry: at most new_capabilities per PR; ids may not name singularities/omegas/etc.; referenced modules must exist
diff_rules_per_pull_request.test_weakening: at most test_weakenings assertion weakenings and deleted_test_files deleted test files per PR

guard.terminal_achievement: truth.achieved == true is accepted only when canonical/governance/TERMINAL_ACHIEVEMENT_OWNER_COUNTERSIGN_V1.json exists AND its SHA-256 equals TERMINAL_ACHIEVED_COUNTERSIGN_SHA256 inside the guard, which is None until the owner edits the guard file in person. No agent can reach terminal truth by editing data.

what_is_and_is_not_impossible.repo_side_guarantee: Every pattern used in the incident is detected and fails the guard; the guard proves on every run that each rule fires (self-test); deleting the guard is caught by the test suite, deleting the test is caught by the guard workflow, deleting both is a PROTECTED_PATH_MODIFIED change.
what_is_and_is_not_impossible.repo_side_limit: An agent acting with the owner's own token and no GitHub-side rules can still push anything, including deletion of the guard. Repository content alone cannot make that impossible; only GitHub-side rules that the agent's token cannot change can.
what_is_and_is_not_impossible.why_github_side_is_possible: Arena's token is a GitHub App installation acting as the owner but WITHOUT the Administration permission (branch-protection API answers 403 'Resource not accessible by integration'). Rules the owner sets in the GitHub UI therefore cannot be edited, disabled, or bypassed by any agent session.
what_is_and_is_not_impossible.current_blocker: moxnixmdj/brain is a private repository on a plan without rulesets/branch protection (rulesets API answers 403 'Upgrade to GitHub Pro or make this repository public'). Until one of the two happens, the guard is a red check the owner must look at before merging, not a lock.

step_0_choose_one: A. Make the repository public: rulesets + required checks + CODEOWNERS enforcement + unlimited Actions minutes become available at no cost (this also removes the carrier/billing floor).
B. Keep it private: restore billing and upgrade to GitHub Pro; rulesets and required checks then work for private repos, and Actions minutes are billed.

step_1_branch_ruleset_main.where: Settings -> Rules -> Rulesets -> New branch ruleset
step_1_branch_ruleset_main.name: main-integrity
step_1_branch_ruleset_main.bypass_list: EMPTY (do not add repository admin; the owner changes the ruleset itself when a legitimate exception is needed)
rules: Require a pull request before merging: required approvals 0; Require review from Code Owners = ON; Dismiss stale approvals = ON; Require approval of the most recent reviewable push = ON
Require status checks to pass: add 'repo-integrity-guard' and 'consistency' (Frontier State Consistency) and 'load-bearing-primary-admission'; Require branches to be up to date = ON
Require conversation resolution before merging = ON
step_1_branch_ruleset_main.effect: No direct push to main by anyone, no merge while the guard is red, and any PR touching a CODEOWNERS path waits for the owner's in-person review. The agent's token cannot create, edit, or bypass this ruleset.

step_2_push_ruleset_optional.where: Settings -> Rules -> Rulesets -> New push ruleset (availability depends on plan)
step_2_push_ruleset_optional.bypass_list: EMPTY; the owner disables the ruleset for the duration of a legitimate edit
step_2_push_ruleset_optional.effect: These files cannot be pushed to ANY branch by any token, which makes tampering with the guard impossible rather than merely detectable.

step_3_repository_settings: Settings -> General -> Pull Requests: disable 'Allow auto-merge'
Settings -> Actions -> General -> Workflow permissions: 'Read repository contents and packages permissions' and UNCHECK 'Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests'
Settings -> Actions -> General: 'Require approval for all outside collaborators' (fork PRs)
github_side.step_4_retire_direct_main_pushes: The 19 legacy workflows in LEGACY_DIRECT_MAIN_PUSH_WORKFLOWS push receipts straight to main; the ruleset will block them. Convert each to push a branch and open a PR, then remove it from the frozen list (the list may only shrink).

honest_baseline.authority: NONE — produced in an Arena session sandbox, not on a carrier; it is a measurement of the tree, not a verification receipt
honest_baseline.measured_at_git_head: cb7e905594620e75fb095ffc91388eb2af008c56 (plus the uncommitted repair in this PR: conftest and pin ledger deleted, two sys.modules stubs removed)
reading: With the deleted conftest in place the same suite reported green: 184 files were replayed against frozen historical commits and 13 interpreter globals were monkeypatched.
Without it, 182 of those 184 files fail against the current tree. These failures were always there; the conftest only hid them.

Most failures are the repository's own currentness guards firing (SOURCE_BLOB_DRIFT / STALE / DRIFT) or assertions against governance documents that no longer match the tree. They are information, not noise, and must be fixed in the runtime or the governance documents — never in the test harness.

About 18 failing records are environment-dependent in the sandbox (cadquery/libGL, openpyxl, instruction_following_eval, blocked network, no docker binary); the remaining ~345 are genuine mismatches between tests and tree.
The single collection error (test_m1b_continuous_geometry_compiler.py) is environmental: cadquery needs libGL, which the sandbox does not have. The CI runner installs it.
Nobody may restore a green suite by pinning, stubbing, skipping, xfail-ing, or loosening these tests. The integrity guard blocks the known ways of doing that; a reviewer must block the rest.
